displayName: Citrus draft engine: VM startup script failed

documentation.content:
**What it means.** `infra/gce/draft-engine-startup.sh` exited non-zero on `citrus-draft-engine-prod` and shipped a `citrus-startup-failed` entry (log-based alert; one notification per 5 minutes at most). The entry carries `exitStatus`, `line`, the unexpanded failing `command`, `logTail` (last 3 lines of /var/log/citrus-startup.log) and `imageUri`. The usual cause is a deploy that pointed `image-tag` metadata at a tag that was never pushed: `docker pull` fails at Step 4, the script stops, and `--restart=always` keeps the PREVIOUS container serving - the engine looks alive while running old code.

**What to do.**
1. Read the entry: `gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/citrus-fantasy-prod/logs/citrus-startup-failed"' --project=citrus-fantasy-prod --freshness=1h --limit=5 --order=desc --format=json`
2. Confirm what is actually running: `gcloud logging read '(jsonPayload.container.metadata.app="citrus-draft-engine") AND jsonPayload.message:"deployment.fingerprint"' --project=citrus-fantasy-prod --limit=1 --order=desc --format='value(jsonPayload.message)'` and compare `imageSha` with the `image-sha` metadata on the VM (`gcloud compute instances describe citrus-draft-engine-prod --zone=northamerica-northeast1-a --format='value(metadata.items)'`).
3. Pull failure (`docker pull` at Step 4): re-point `image-tag` / `image-sha` / `commit-sha` at the last good digest and `reset` per `docs/DEPLOY_PROTOCOL_F26_F27.md` section 4b (retag -> metadata revert -> reset) and `docs/RUNBOOKS/draft-engine-v2-rollback-playbook.md` Scenario 2. Secret failure (Step 3 FATAL): check Secret Manager access / value per `docs/RUNBOOKS/draft-engine-v2-operations.md` section 2.1 and 5.2.
4. Do NOT restart the VM mid-draft: the freeze rule in `docs/DEPLOY_PROTOCOL_F26_F27.md` section 4d still applies.

Managed by `infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-monitoring.sh` (`alert-startup-failed.json`). The startup-script trap only runs on the VM after `--metadata-from-file=startup-script=` is re-applied.
